flashcards.definition: Non-physical or conceptual yet underpinned by something physical or actual.
flashcards.example: Logical memory appears contiguous to an application program, but may well be stored on several physical devices, including in RAM and on hard-disks, as determined by the operating system.
flashcards.definitionZh: 非物理或概念性的，但以物理或实际的东西为基础。
flashcards.exampleZh: 逻辑内存看起来与应用程序相邻，但很可能存储在多个物理设备上，包括 RAM 和硬盘，具体由操作系统决定。

flashcards.definition: The context in general of a particular political, moral etc. situation.
flashcards.example: Industries that require a lot of fossil fuels are unlikely to be popular in the current political climate.
flashcards.definitionZh: 特定政治、道德等情况的一般背景。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在当前的政治气候下，需要大量化石燃料的行业不太可能受到欢迎。

flashcards.definition: Darkness where light, particularly sunlight, is blocked.
flashcards.example: The old oak tree gave shade in the heat of the day.
flashcards.definitionZh: 光线（尤其是阳光）被阻挡的黑暗。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这棵老橡树在炎热的天气里提供了阴凉。

flashcards.definition: A dark image projected onto a surface where light (or other radiation) is blocked by the shade of an object.
flashcards.example: My shadow lengthened as the sun began to set.
flashcards.definitionZh: 投影到光（或其他辐射）被物体的阴影阻挡的表面上的暗图像。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当太阳开始落山时，我的影子拉长了。

flashcards.definition: Someone who devises or suggests a project; a proposer or planner of something.
flashcards.example: This is the word Projector.
flashcards.definitionZh: 设计或建议项目的人；某事的提议者或计划者。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是投影仪这个词。

flashcards.definition: The maximum width of a vessel (note that a vessel with a beam of 15 foot can also be said to be 15 foot abeam)
flashcards.example: This ship has more beam than that one.
flashcards.definitionZh: 船舶的最大宽度（请注意，横梁为 15 英尺的船舶也可以说是横梁 15 英尺）
flashcards.exampleZh: 这艘船的横梁比那艘多。

flashcards.definition: Of a thing, outdated or no longer in vogue.
flashcards.example: My bike is old-fashioned but it gets me around.
flashcards.definitionZh: 过时或不再流行的事物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我的自行车是老式的，但它可以让我到处走走。

flashcards.definition: That which promotes good spirits or cheerfulness; provisions prepared for a feast; entertainment.
flashcards.example: a table loaded with good cheer
flashcards.definitionZh: 促进良好精神或快乐的事物；为宴会准备的食物；娱乐。
flashcards.exampleZh: 满桌欢乐

flashcards.definition: That which promotes good spirits or cheerfulness; provisions prepared for a feast; entertainment.
flashcards.example: a table loaded with good cheer
flashcards.definitionZh: 促进良好精神或快乐的事物；为宴会准备的食物；娱乐。
flashcards.exampleZh: 满桌欢乐

flashcards.definition: To manage, control, steer.
flashcards.example: to direct the affairs of a nation or the movements of an army
flashcards.definitionZh: 管理、控制、引导。
flashcards.exampleZh: 指挥国家事务或军队行动

flashcards.definition: The physical confine of a river or slough, consisting of a bed and banks.
flashcards.example: The water coming out of the waterwheel created a standing wave in the channel.
flashcards.definitionZh: 河流或泥沼的物理范围，由河床和河岸组成。
flashcards.exampleZh: 从水车出来的水在河道中产生驻波。

flashcards.definition: Spinning or rotary motion given to a ball around the vertical axis, as in billiards or bowling.
flashcards.example: You can't hit it directly, but maybe if you give it some english.
flashcards.definitionZh: 球绕垂直轴的旋转或旋转运动，如台球或保龄球。
flashcards.exampleZh: 你不能直接点击它，但如果你给它一些英语也许可以。

flashcards.definition: A gentle bend, such as in a road.
flashcards.example: You should slow down when approaching a curve.
flashcards.definitionZh: 温和的转弯，例如在道路上。
flashcards.exampleZh: 接近弯道时应减速。

flashcards.definition: A sequence of events.
flashcards.example: The normal course of events seems to be just one damned thing after another.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一系列事件。
flashcards.exampleZh: 事件的正常进程似乎只是一件又一件该死的事情。

flashcards.definition: (usually in phrases such as 'from the off', 'at the off', etc.) Beginning; starting point.
flashcards.example: He has been very obviously an untrustworthy narrator right from the off.
flashcards.definitionZh: （通常用“from the off”、“at the off”等短语） 开始；起点。
flashcards.exampleZh: 显然，他从一开始就是一个不值得信任的叙述者。

flashcards.definition: Existing or occurring at the moment
flashcards.example: current events;  current leaders;  current negotiations
flashcards.definitionZh: 存在或此时发生
flashcards.exampleZh: 时事;  现任领导；  目前的谈判

flashcards.definition: In a direct manner; in a straight line or course.
flashcards.example: He drove directly to the office, and didn't stop off at the petrol station.
flashcards.definitionZh: 以直接的方式；沿直线或路线。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他直接开车去办公室，没有在加油站停车。

flashcards.definition: Anything that is typical, normal, or standard.
flashcards.example: Among the moths, typicals were more common than melanics.
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何典型的、正常的或标准的东西。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在飞蛾中，典型飞蛾比黑色飞蛾更常见。

flashcards.definition: Primary site of disease; original location or source of the disease.
flashcards.example: most common primaries
flashcards.definitionZh: 原发病灶；疾病的原始位置或来源。
flashcards.exampleZh: 最常见的初选

flashcards.definition: One who occupies a subordinate or auxiliary place; a delegate deputy.
flashcards.example: the secondary, or undersheriff, of the city of London
flashcards.definitionZh: 占据从属或辅助地位的人；一名代表。
flashcards.exampleZh: 伦敦市的二级警长或副警长

flashcards.definition: To spend time socially; keep company.
flashcards.example: She associates with her coworkers on weekends.
flashcards.definitionZh: 花时间参加社交活动；做伴。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她周末与同事交往。

flashcards.definition: A person with common characteristics, being of the same kind, or in the same group.
flashcards.example: Roger and his fellow workers are to go on strike.
flashcards.definitionZh: 具有共同特征、同类或同一群体的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 罗杰和他的工友将举行罢工。

flashcards.definition: A long-standing group of people sharing cultural aspects such as language, dress, norms of behavior and artistic forms.
flashcards.example: This society has been known for centuries for its colorful clothing and tight-knit family structure.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个长期存在的群体，在语言、服饰、行为规范和艺术形式等方面有着共同的文化。
flashcards.exampleZh: 几个世纪以来，这个社会以其色彩缤纷的服装和紧密的家庭结构而闻名。

flashcards.definition: A percentage, a proportion (especially per hundred).
flashcards.example: only a small percent attain the top ranks
flashcards.definitionZh: 百分比，比例（尤其是每一百）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 只有一小部分人达到最高排名

flashcards.definition: Someone who watches over something; a person in charge of something or someone.
flashcards.example: The camp monitors look after the children during the night, when the teachers are asleep.
flashcards.definitionZh: 监视某事的人；负责某事或某人的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 夜间，当老师们睡觉时，营地的监护人会照顾孩子们。

flashcards.definition: To close the mouth of a hook by a careful binding of marline or wire.
flashcards.example: Captain Higgins moused the hook with a bit of marline to prevent the block beckets from falling out under slack.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用马线或铁丝小心地绑住钩子的嘴。
flashcards.exampleZh: 希金斯船长用一点马林鱼固定钩子，以防止吊钩因松弛而掉落。

flashcards.definition: To type on a computer keyboard.
flashcards.example: Keyboarding is the part of this job I hate the most.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在电脑键盘上打字。
flashcards.exampleZh: 敲键盘是这份工作中我最讨厌的部分。

flashcards.definition: One who makes prints.
flashcards.example: This is the word Printer.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一位制作版画的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是打印机这个词。

flashcards.definition: A brief, sharp, not particularly loud, relatively high-pitched sound produced by the impact of something small and hard against something hard, such as by the operation of a switch, a lock or a latch, or a finger pressed against the thumb and then released to strike the hand.
flashcards.example: I turned the key, the lock gave a click and the door opened;  a click of one’s fingers
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种短促、尖锐、不是特别响亮、相对高亢的声音，由小而硬的物体撞击坚硬的物体而产生，例如通过操作开关、锁或闩锁，或者手指压在拇指上然后松开以敲击手。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我转动钥匙，锁发出“咔哒”一声，门开了。  轻轻一按

flashcards.definition: One who watches an event; especially, one held outdoors.
flashcards.example: The cheering spectators watched the fireworks.
flashcards.definitionZh: 观看活动的人；尤其是在户外举行的一场。
flashcards.exampleZh: 欢呼雀跃的观众观看了烟花表演。

flashcards.definition: (especially Britain) A group of sporting activities including track and field, road running, cross country and racewalking.
flashcards.example: This is the word Athletics.
flashcards.definitionZh: （特别是英国）一组体育活动，包括田径、路跑、越野和竞走。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是田径这个词。

flashcards.definition: To win a medal.
flashcards.example: He medalled twice at the Olympics.
flashcards.definitionZh: 赢得奖牌。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他在奥运会上两次获得奖牌。

flashcards.definition: A hideout for bad people to frequent or haunt; a den.
flashcards.example: That nightclub is a nest of strange people!
flashcards.definitionZh: 坏人经常出没或出没的藏身之处；一个书房。
flashcards.exampleZh: 那家夜总会是一群奇怪的人！

flashcards.definition: An interpretation or view, opinion or assessment; perspective.
flashcards.example: What's your take on this issue, Fred?
flashcards.definitionZh: 解释或观点、意见或评估；看法。
flashcards.exampleZh: 弗雷德，你对这个问题有何看法？

flashcards.definition: Dexterity of speech or action; skill, talent.
flashcards.example: The facility she shows in playing the violin is unrivalled.
flashcards.definitionZh: 言语或行动的灵巧性；技能，天赋。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她在拉小提琴方面所表现出的天赋是无与伦比的。

flashcards.definition: Very uncommon; scarce.
flashcards.example: Black pearls are very rare and therefore very valuable.
flashcards.definitionZh: 非常罕见；稀缺。
flashcards.exampleZh: 黑珍珠非常稀有，因此非常有价值。

flashcards.definition: To humiliate; to disrupt somebody's composure or comfort with acting publicly or freely; to disconcert; to abash
flashcards.example: The crowd's laughter and jeers embarrassed him.
flashcards.definitionZh: 羞辱；扰乱某人公开或自由行事的冷静或舒适感；使不安；羞辱
flashcards.exampleZh: 人群的笑声和嘲笑让他感到尴尬。

flashcards.definition: To frighten, terrify, startle, especially in a minor way.
flashcards.example: Did it scare you when I said "Boo!"?
flashcards.definitionZh: 惊吓，恐惧，惊吓，尤其是轻微的惊吓。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当我说“嘘！”时，你被吓到了吗？

flashcards.definition: Payment for the temporary use of something.
flashcards.example: The sign offered pedalos on hire.
flashcards.definitionZh: 临时使用某物的付款。
flashcards.exampleZh: 标牌上提供脚踏船出租服务。

flashcards.definition: One who works in or with lead.
flashcards.example: This is the word Plumber.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在铅中或与铅一起工作的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是水管工这个词。

flashcards.definition: Very large.
flashcards.example: The castle was huge.
flashcards.definitionZh: 非常大。
flashcards.exampleZh: 城堡很大。

flashcards.definition: Unhappy because of feeling isolated from contact with other people.
flashcards.example: This is the word Lonely.
flashcards.definitionZh: 因为与他人接触而感到孤立而感到不快乐。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是孤独这个词。

flashcards.definition: The action or power of describing, explaining, or making definite and clear.
flashcards.example: Her comic genius is beyond definition.
flashcards.definitionZh: 描述、解释或明确明确的行动或力量。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她的喜剧天赋是无法定义的。

flashcards.definition: A burden; a weight to be carried.
flashcards.example: I struggled up the hill with the heavy load in my rucksack.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个负担；要携带的重量。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我背着沉重的背包，艰难地爬上山。

flashcards.definition: Brand or kind; model.
flashcards.example: What make of car do you drive?
flashcards.definitionZh: 品牌或种类；模型。
flashcards.exampleZh: 您开什么牌子的车？

flashcards.definition: Brand or kind; model.
flashcards.example: What make of car do you drive?
flashcards.definitionZh: 品牌或种类；模型。
flashcards.exampleZh: 您开什么牌子的车？

flashcards.definition: A contest, especially for spelling; see spelling bee.
flashcards.example: geography bee
flashcards.definitionZh: 一场比赛，尤其是拼写比赛；参见拼字比赛。
flashcards.exampleZh: 地理蜜蜂

flashcards.definition: A contest, especially for spelling; see spelling bee.
flashcards.example: geography bee
flashcards.definitionZh: 一场比赛，尤其是拼写比赛；参见拼字比赛。
flashcards.exampleZh: 地理蜜蜂

flashcards.definition: An artistic quality that appeals to or evokes the emotions, in any medium; something having such a quality.
flashcards.example: That 'Swan Lake' choreography is poetry in motion, fitting the musical poetry of Tchaikovski's divine score well beyond the literary inspiration.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在任何媒介中都能吸引或唤起情感的艺术品质；具有这种品质的东西。
flashcards.exampleZh: 《天鹅湖》的编舞是运动中的诗歌，契合柴可夫斯基神圣乐谱的音乐诗意，远远超出了文学灵感。

flashcards.definition: The act of measuring.
flashcards.example: This is the word Measurement.
flashcards.definitionZh: 测量的行为。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“测量”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A piece of information describing, or an account of certain events given or presented to someone, with the most common adpositions being by (referring to creator of the report) and on (referring to the subject).
flashcards.example: A report by the telecommunications ministry on the phone network revealed a severe capacity problem.
flashcards.definitionZh: 描述或呈现给某人的某些事件的一条信息，最常见的介词是“by”（指报告的创建者）和“on”（指主题）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 电信部关于电话网络的一份报告揭示了严重的容量问题。

flashcards.definition: Someone or something that reports.
flashcards.example: The reporters of important security bugs may be paid a bounty by the software developer.
flashcards.definitionZh: 报告的某人或某事。
flashcards.exampleZh: 软件开发商可能会向报告重要安全漏洞的人支付奖金。

flashcards.definition: Action or conduct that is inappropriate, improper, incorrect, or unexpected.
flashcards.example: The teacher did not tolerate misbehavior in his classroom.
flashcards.definitionZh: 不适当、不当、不正确或意外的行动或行为。
flashcards.exampleZh: 老师不能容忍课堂上的不当行为。

flashcards.definition: In good health.
flashcards.example: I had been sick, but now I'm well.
flashcards.definitionZh: 身体健康。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我本来病过，但现在好了。

flashcards.definition: To put (something) down, to rest.
flashcards.example: Set the tray there.
flashcards.definitionZh: 放下（某物），休息。
flashcards.exampleZh: 将托盘放在那里。

flashcards.definition: To sanction officially; to ratify; to confirm; to set as satisfactory.
flashcards.example: Although we may disagree with it, we must nevertheless approve the sentence handed down by the court-martial.
flashcards.definitionZh: 正式批准；批准；确认；设置为满意。
flashcards.exampleZh: 尽管我们可能不同意，但我们必须批准军事法庭的判决。

flashcards.definition: To condemn; to consider wrong or inappropriate; used with of.
flashcards.example: She disapproves of rap music because of its sometimes aggressive lyrics.
flashcards.definitionZh: 谴责；认为错误或不适当；与 of 一起使用。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她不赞成说唱音乐，因为它有时带有攻击性的歌词。

flashcards.definition: An expression granting permission; an indication of agreement with a proposal; an acknowledgement that a person, thing or event meets requirements.
flashcards.example: I need to get an approval on this purchase order.
flashcards.definitionZh: 授予许可的表达方式；表示同意某项提案；承认一个人、事物或事件满足要求。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我需要获得此采购订单的批准。

flashcards.definition: The act of disapproving; condemnation.
flashcards.example: This is the word Disapproval.
flashcards.definitionZh: 不赞成的行为；谴责。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是不赞成这个词。

flashcards.definition: A mark left by something that has passed along.
flashcards.example: Can you see any tracks in the snow?
flashcards.definitionZh: 已经过去的事物留下的痕迹。
flashcards.exampleZh: 你能看到雪中的痕迹吗？

flashcards.definition: To control or manage, be in charge of.
flashcards.example: He is running the candidate's expensive campaign.
flashcards.definitionZh: 控制或管理，负责。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他正在负责这位候选人耗资巨大的竞选活动。

flashcards.definition: Meaning of the word railway-track.
flashcards.example: This is the word railway-track.
flashcards.definitionZh: 铁路轨道这个词的含义。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是铁路轨道这个词。

flashcards.definition: Books and other material created by printing presses, considered collectively or as a medium.
flashcards.example: TV and the internet haven't killed print.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由印刷机制作的书籍和其他材料，统称为或作为媒介。
flashcards.exampleZh: 电视和互联网并没有消灭印刷品。

flashcards.definition: By extension, a plan or procedure to obtain a given end result; a prescription.
flashcards.example: His new approach is definitely a recipe for success.
flashcards.definitionZh: 推而广之，是获得给定最终结果的计划或程序；处方。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他的新方法绝对是成功的秘诀。

flashcards.definition: Having resemblance or similitude; similar; without difference.
flashcards.example: The twins were alike.
flashcards.definitionZh: 具有相似性或相似性；相似的;无差异。
flashcards.exampleZh: 双胞胎很相似。

flashcards.definition: (usually in the plural) Something that a person likes (prefers).
flashcards.example: Tell me your likes and dislikes.
flashcards.definitionZh: （通常为复数）一个人喜欢（喜欢）的东西。
flashcards.exampleZh: 告诉我你的喜欢和不喜欢。

flashcards.definition: Something which consists of various components, such as a piece of computer software.
flashcards.example: Did you test the software package to ensure completeness?
flashcards.definitionZh: 由各种组件组成的东西，例如计算机软件。
flashcards.exampleZh: 您是否测试了软件包以确保完整性？

flashcards.definition: A package wrapped for shipment.
flashcards.example: I saw a brown paper parcel on my doorstep.
flashcards.definitionZh: 包装好待运输的包裹。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我看到我家门口有一个牛皮纸包裹。

flashcards.definition: A small pack or package; a little bundle or parcel
flashcards.example: Don't throw the crisp packet on the floor!
flashcards.definitionZh: 小包装或包裹；一小捆或包裹
flashcards.exampleZh: 不要将薯片包扔在地板上！

flashcards.definition: A single hut or shelter.
flashcards.example: a hunter's camp
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个单独的小屋或避难所。
flashcards.exampleZh: 猎人营地

flashcards.definition: To live in a tent or similar temporary accommodation.
flashcards.example: We're planning to camp in the field until Sunday.
flashcards.definitionZh: 住在帐篷或类似的临时住处。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们计划在野外露营直到周日。

flashcards.definition: A place where a tent may be or is pitched.
flashcards.example: This is the word Campsite.
flashcards.definitionZh: 可能或正在搭建帐篷的地方。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“露营地”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A pavilion or portable lodge consisting of skins, canvas, or some strong cloth, stretched and sustained by poles, used for sheltering people from the weather.
flashcards.example: We were camping in a three-man tent.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由兽皮、帆布或一些坚固的布料组成的凉亭或便携式小屋，由杆子拉伸和支撑，用于为人们遮风挡雨。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们在一个三人帐篷里露营。

flashcards.definition: A seat (tack) for a rider placed on the back of a horse or other animal.
flashcards.example: This is the word Saddle.
flashcards.definitionZh: 骑手放置在马或其他动物背上的座位（马具）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是马鞍这个词。

flashcards.definition: A main road or highway, especially in ancient Rome. (Mainly used in set phrases, below.)
flashcards.example: This is the word Via.
flashcards.definitionZh: 主要道路或高速公路，尤其是在古罗马。 （主要用于固定短语，见下文。）
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“维亚”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A spoken test or examination, particularly in a language class.
flashcards.example: We've got our Spanish oral tomorrow.
flashcards.definitionZh: 口语测试或考试，特别是在语言课上。
flashcards.exampleZh: 明天我们有西班牙语口语。

flashcards.definition: To send something by messenger.
flashcards.example: I'll messenger over the signed documents.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过信使发送东西。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我会把签署的文件转达给你。

flashcards.definition: Concern or responsibility.
flashcards.example: it's his/her pigeon
flashcards.definitionZh: 关心或责任。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是他/她的鸽子

flashcards.definition: The person who chases and tries to catch the other players in the playground game of tag.
flashcards.example: In the next game, Adam and Tom will be it…
flashcards.definitionZh: 在操场上的捉人游戏中追逐并试图抓住其他玩家的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在下一场比赛中，亚当和汤姆将是……

flashcards.definition: A pulsation or throb.
flashcards.example: a beat of the heart; the beat of the pulse
flashcards.definitionZh: 脉动或搏动。
flashcards.exampleZh: 心跳；脉搏的跳动

flashcards.definition: A leader or head of a group of people, organisation, etc.
flashcards.example: All firefighters report to the fire chief.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一群人、组织等的领导者或负责人
flashcards.exampleZh: 所有消防员均向消防队长报告。

flashcards.definition: (stock breeding) A family of animals descended from some particular female progenitor, through the female line.
flashcards.example: the Duchess tribe of shorthorns
flashcards.definitionZh: （畜牧业）由某个特定雌性祖先通过雌性谱系传下来的动物家族。
flashcards.exampleZh: 短角羚公爵夫人部落

flashcards.definition: To sadden or displease (someone) by underperforming, or by not delivering something promised or hoped for.
flashcards.example: His lack of respect disappointed her.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由于表现不佳或未兑现承诺或希望的事情而使（某人）感到悲伤或不悦。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他的不尊重令她失望。

flashcards.definition: That which causes feelings of disappointment.
flashcards.example: Our trip to California was a disappointment.
flashcards.definitionZh: 导致失望感的事情。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们的加州之旅令人失望。

flashcards.definition: (usually in the plural) Something that is fine; fine particles.
flashcards.example: They filtered silt and fines out of the soil.
flashcards.definitionZh: （通常为复数）很好的东西；细颗粒。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们从土壤中过滤掉淤泥和细粉。

flashcards.definition: Higher in quality.
flashcards.example: Rebecca had always thought shorts were far superior to pants, as they didn't constantly make her legs itch.
flashcards.definitionZh: 质量更高。
flashcards.exampleZh: 丽贝卡一直认为短裤比裤子优越得多，因为它们不会经常让她的腿发痒。

flashcards.definition: An act of sorting.
flashcards.example: I had a sort of my cupboard.
flashcards.definitionZh: 排序的行为。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我有一个类似我的橱柜的东西。

flashcards.definition: An act of sorting.
flashcards.example: I had a sort of my cupboard.
flashcards.definitionZh: 排序的行为。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我有一个类似我的橱柜的东西。

flashcards.definition: To break down and reuse component materials.
flashcards.example: Both paper and plastic can be recycled.
flashcards.definitionZh: 分解和再利用组件材料。
flashcards.exampleZh: 纸张和塑料都可以回收利用。

flashcards.definition: Refuse, waste, garbage, junk, trash.
flashcards.example: The rubbish is collected every Thursday in Gloucester, but on Wednesdays in Cheltenham.
flashcards.definitionZh: 垃圾，废物，垃圾，垃圾，垃圾。
flashcards.exampleZh: 格洛斯特每周四收集垃圾，切尔滕纳姆每周三收集垃圾。

flashcards.definition: A small valley between mountains.
flashcards.example: He built himself a cabin in a hollow high up in the Rockies.
flashcards.definitionZh: 群山之间的一个小山谷。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他在落基山脉高处的一个洼地里为自己建造了一间小屋。

flashcards.definition: A favor.
flashcards.example: I owe him; he did me a solid last year.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个恩惠。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我欠他的；去年他给了我很大的帮助。

flashcards.definition: A loss of greatness or status.
flashcards.example: the fall of Rome
flashcards.definitionZh: 失去伟大或地位。
flashcards.exampleZh: 罗马的陷落

flashcards.definition: With a comparative or with more and a verb phrase, establishes a correlation with one or more other such comparatives.
flashcards.example: It looks weaker and weaker, the more I think about it.
flashcards.definitionZh: 与比较级或 more 和动词短语一起使用，与一个或多个其他此类比较级建立关联。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我越想，它看起来就越弱。

flashcards.definition: A snack food made from corn/maize kernels popped by dry heating.
flashcards.example: This is the word Popcorn.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种由玉米/玉米粒经干热爆裂制成的休闲食品。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是爆米花这个词。

flashcards.definition: To portray visually; to delineate
flashcards.example: The sculptor represented a horse in bronze.
flashcards.definitionZh: 以视觉方式描绘；描绘
flashcards.exampleZh: 雕塑家用青铜描绘了一匹马。

flashcards.definition: Representing, showing a likeness.
flashcards.example: Are you sure this paper is representative of your child's writing?
flashcards.definitionZh: 代表、表现出相似性。
flashcards.exampleZh: 您确定这篇论文能够代表您孩子的写作吗？

flashcards.definition: To be symbolic of; to represent.
flashcards.example: This is the word Symbolize.
flashcards.definitionZh: 具有象征意义；代表。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“象征”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A ritual, with religious or cultural significance.
flashcards.example: This is the word Ceremony.
flashcards.definitionZh: 具有宗教或文化意义的仪式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是仪式这个词。

flashcards.definition: Uncomfortable or painful feeling due to recognition or consciousness of one's own impropriety or dishonor or something being exposed that should have been kept private.
flashcards.example: The teenager couldn’t bear the shame of introducing his parents.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由于认识到或意识到自己的不当行为或不名誉或本应保密的事情被曝光而产生的不舒服或痛苦的感觉。
flashcards.exampleZh: 少年无法忍受介绍自己父母的耻辱。

flashcards.definition: To feel shame; to be ashamed.
flashcards.example: This is the word Ashamed.
flashcards.definitionZh: 感到羞耻；感到羞耻。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是羞耻这个词。

flashcards.definition: Exclamation; outcry, clamor.
flashcards.example: This is the word Exclaim.
flashcards.definitionZh: 感叹;叫嚷，叫嚣。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是感叹这个词。

flashcards.definition: Letters or words, in writing or speech, that have no meaning or pattern or seem to have no meaning.
flashcards.example: After my father had a stroke, every time he tried to talk, it sounded like nonsense.
flashcards.definitionZh: 书面或演讲中没有意义或模式或似乎没有意义的字母或单词。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我父亲中风后，每次他想说话，听起来都是废话。

flashcards.definition: Pedestrians or vehicles on roads, or the flux or passage thereof.
flashcards.example: The traffic is slow during rush hour.
flashcards.definitionZh: 道路上的行人或车辆，或其流动或通行。
flashcards.exampleZh: 高峰时段交通缓慢。

flashcards.definition: Strong of its kind or in character; unmitigated; virulent; thorough; utter (used of negative things).
flashcards.example: rank nonsense
flashcards.definitionZh: 同类或性格上的坚强；毫无缓解；有毒的；彻底; utter（用于负面事物）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 胡说八道

flashcards.definition: A naval officer of the highest rank; the commander of a country's naval forces.
flashcards.example: This is the word Admiral.
flashcards.definitionZh: 最高级别的海军军官；一个国家的海军司令。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是海军上将这个词。

flashcards.definition: A person who makes, repairs, or alters clothes professionally, especially suits and men's clothing.
flashcards.example: He works as a tailor on Swanston Street.
flashcards.definitionZh: 专业制作、修理或改造衣服的人，尤其是西装和男装。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他在斯旺斯顿街做裁缝。

flashcards.definition: A person who makes tailor-made women's clothes.
flashcards.example: This is the word Dressmaker.
flashcards.definitionZh: 量身定做女装的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是裁缝这个词。

flashcards.definition: A software tool for designing things.
flashcards.example: a font designer
flashcards.definitionZh: 用于设计事物的软件工具。
flashcards.exampleZh: 字体设计师

flashcards.definition: (usually uncountable) Luggage; traveling equipment
flashcards.example: Please put your baggage in the trunk.
flashcards.definitionZh: （通常不可数）行李；旅行装备
flashcards.exampleZh: 请将您的行李放入行李箱。

flashcards.definition: An entertainment, outing, food, drink, or other indulgence provided by someone for the enjoyment of others.
flashcards.example: Here are some healthy Halloween treats for ghouls and witches of all ages.
flashcards.definitionZh: 某人为了他人的享受而提供的娱乐、郊游、食物、饮料或其他放纵。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这里有一些适合各个年龄段的食尸鬼和女巫的健康万圣节美食。

flashcards.definition: The process or manner of treating someone or something.
flashcards.example: He still has nightmares resulting from the treatment he received from his captors.
flashcards.definitionZh: 治疗某人或某事的过程或方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他仍然会因为绑架者的待遇而做噩梦。

flashcards.definition: A sudden, heavy impact.
flashcards.example: The train hit the buffers with a great shock.
flashcards.definitionZh: 突然的、沉重的冲击。
flashcards.exampleZh: 火车猛地撞到了缓冲器上。

flashcards.definition: That which is allowed; a share or portion allotted or granted; a sum granted as a reimbursement, a bounty, or as appropriate for any purpose; a stated quantity.
flashcards.example: her meagre allowance of food or drink
flashcards.definitionZh: 允许的；分配或授予的股份或部分；作为报销、赏金或酌情用于任何目的而授予的金额；规定的数量。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她微薄的食物或饮料

flashcards.definition: Brand or kind; model.
flashcards.example: What make of car do you drive?
flashcards.definitionZh: 品牌或种类；模型。
flashcards.exampleZh: 您开什么牌子的车？

flashcards.definition: To request the help of someone, often in the form of money.
flashcards.example: He begged on the street corner from passers-by.
flashcards.definitionZh: 请求某人的帮助，通常以金钱的形式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他在街角向路人乞讨。

flashcards.definition: To pardon; to waive any negative feeling or desire for punishment, retribution, or compensation.
flashcards.example: Forgive others, not because they deserve forgiveness, but because you deserve peace.
flashcards.definitionZh: 宽恕；放弃任何负面情绪或对惩罚、报复或补偿的渴望。
flashcards.exampleZh: 宽恕别人，不是因为他们值得宽恕，而是因为你值得平安。

flashcards.definition: The action of forgiving.
flashcards.example: This is the word Forgiveness.
flashcards.definitionZh: 宽恕的行动。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是宽恕这个词。

flashcards.definition: Forgiveness for an offence.
flashcards.example: This is the word Pardon.
flashcards.definitionZh: 对冒犯的宽恕。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是赦免这个词。

flashcards.definition: The name of the Latin-script letter I.
flashcards.example: the position of an i-dot (the dot of an i)
flashcards.definitionZh: 拉丁字母 I 的名称。
flashcards.exampleZh: i-dot 的位置（i 的点）

flashcards.definition: An abnormal condition of a human, animal or plant that causes discomfort or dysfunction; distinct from injury insofar as the latter is usually instantaneously acquired.
flashcards.example: The tomato plants had some kind of disease that left their leaves splotchy and fruit withered.
flashcards.definitionZh: 导致不适或功能障碍的人类、动物或植物的异常状况；与伤害不同，后者通常是瞬时获得的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 番茄植株患有某种疾病，导致叶子出现斑点，果实枯萎。

flashcards.definition: (of a disease) Easily transmitted to others.
flashcards.example: The flu was so contagious that everybody in town got sick!
flashcards.definitionZh: （疾病）容易传染给他人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 流感的传染性如此之大，以至于镇上的每个人都生病了！

flashcards.definition: An acute contagious disease of the upper airways and lungs, caused by a virus, which rapidly spreads around the world in seasonal epidemics.
flashcards.example: This is the word Influenza flu.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种由病毒引起的上呼吸道和肺部的急性传染病，在世界各地以季节性流行病形式迅速传播。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是流感一词。

flashcards.definition: Typhoid fever
flashcards.example: This is the word Typhoid.
flashcards.definitionZh: 伤寒
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是伤寒这个词。

flashcards.definition: An instance of this chemical reaction, especially when intentionally created and maintained in a specific location to a useful end (such as a campfire or a hearth fire).
flashcards.example: We sat about the fire singing songs and telling tales.
flashcards.definitionZh: 这种化学反应的一个实例，特别是当故意在特定位置产生并维持以达到有用目的时（例如篝火或炉火）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们坐在火边唱歌、讲故事。

flashcards.definition: (with possessive pronoun) (One's) bedroom.
flashcards.example: Go to your room!
flashcards.definitionZh: （带有所有格代词）（一个人的）卧室。
flashcards.exampleZh: 去你的房间吧！

flashcards.definition: A homogeneous mixture, which may be liquid, gas or solid, formed by dissolving one or more substances.
flashcards.example: This is the word Solution.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过溶解一种或多种物质形成的均匀混合物，可以是液体、气体或固体。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“解决方案”这个词。

flashcards.definition: To spray with liquid from a container.
flashcards.example: Farmers may either dip or jet sheep with chemicals.
flashcards.definitionZh: 从容器中喷出液体。
flashcards.exampleZh: 农民可以用化学品给羊浸泡或喷射。

flashcards.definition: The symbol ♯, placed after the name of a note in the key signature or before a note on the staff to indicate that the note is to be played a semitone higher.
flashcards.example: The pitch pipe sounded out a perfect F♯ (F sharp).
flashcards.definitionZh: 符号 ♯ 放置在调号中的音符名称之后或五线谱上的音符之前，表示该音符要演奏高半音。
flashcards.exampleZh: 音管发出完美的F♯（升F）音。

flashcards.definition: A series of events which produce a result (the product).
flashcards.example: This product of last month's quality standards committee is quite good, even though the process was flawed.
flashcards.definitionZh: 产生结果（产品）的一系列事件。
flashcards.exampleZh: 上个月质量标准委员会的这个产品相当不错，尽管工艺有缺陷。

flashcards.definition: (of materials, products, etc.) Not treated or processed; in a natural state, unrefined, unprocessed.
flashcards.example: raw cane sugar
flashcards.definitionZh: （材料、产品等）未经处理或加工；处于自然状态，未精制、未加工。
flashcards.exampleZh: 原蔗糖

flashcards.definition: A part or snippet of something taken or presented for inspection, or shown as evidence of the quality of the whole; a specimen.
flashcards.example: a blood sample
flashcards.definitionZh: 为检查而采取或呈现的某物的一部分或片段，或作为整体质量的证据；一个标本。
flashcards.exampleZh: 血液样本

flashcards.definition: Of, relating to, or being an undergraduate.
flashcards.example: After completing my undergraduate studies, I embarked on a career in publishing.
flashcards.definitionZh: 本科生的、关于本科生的或作为本科生的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 完成本科学业后，我开始了出版生涯。

flashcards.definition: A person who is recognized by a university as having completed the requirements of a degree studied at the institution.
flashcards.example: If the government wants graduates to stay in the country they should offer more incentives.
flashcards.definitionZh: 被大学认可为已完成在该机构学习的学位要求的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 如果政府希望毕业生留在国内，他们应该提供更多激励措施。

flashcards.definition: Effecting no purpose; pointless, futile.
flashcards.example: vain toil;  a vain attempt
flashcards.definitionZh: 没有达到任何目的；无意义的，徒劳的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 徒劳的劳作；  徒劳的尝试

flashcards.definition: A position of power or influence, or a way to get it.
flashcards.example: His parents got him an in with the company.
flashcards.definitionZh: 权力或影响力的地位，或者获得它的方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他的父母让他加入了这家公司。

flashcards.word: As long as so long as
flashcards.definition: To such an extent or degree; to the same extent or degree.
flashcards.example: It's not as well made, but it's twice as expensive.
flashcards.definitionZh: 达到这样的程度；达到相同的程度或程度。
flashcards.exampleZh: 虽然做工不太好，但价格却贵了一倍。

flashcards.definition: (usually with over) To complete.
flashcards.example: They say they can turn the parts in two days.
flashcards.definitionZh: （通常与over）一起完成。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们说他们可以在两天内转动零件。

flashcards.definition: (usually with over) To complete.
flashcards.example: They say they can turn the parts in two days.
flashcards.definitionZh: （通常与over）一起完成。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们说他们可以在两天内转动零件。

flashcards.definition: (usually with over) To complete.
flashcards.example: They say they can turn the parts in two days.
flashcards.definitionZh: （通常与over）一起完成。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们说他们可以在两天内转动零件。

flashcards.definition: Ill, unwell.
flashcards.example: He's never badly.
flashcards.definitionZh: 生病了，身体不好。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他从来都不是坏人。

flashcards.definition: Pedestrians or vehicles on roads, or the flux or passage thereof.
flashcards.example: The traffic is slow during rush hour.
flashcards.definitionZh: 道路上的行人或车辆，或其流动或通行。
flashcards.exampleZh: 高峰时段交通缓慢。

flashcards.definition: To make an error in judging, to incorrectly assess.
flashcards.example: I misjudged you. I don't like your politics but I appreciate your loyalty to your friends.
flashcards.definitionZh: 判断错误，评估错误。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我误判你了。我不喜欢你的政治观点，但我欣赏你对朋友的忠诚。

flashcards.definition: An animal's tail.
flashcards.example: This is the word Queue.
flashcards.definitionZh: 动物的尾巴。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是队列这个词。

flashcards.definition: An instance of propelling oneself upwards.
flashcards.example: The boy took a skip and a jump down the lane.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个推动自己向上的例子。
flashcards.exampleZh: 男孩沿着小巷一蹦一跳。

flashcards.definition: With a loud voice, or great noise; loudly; audibly.
flashcards.example: Try speaking aloud rather than whispering.
flashcards.definitionZh: 声音很大，或者噪音很大；高声;听得见。
flashcards.exampleZh: 尝试大声说话而不是小声说话。

flashcards.definition: A round or irregular patch on the surface of a thing having a different color, texture etc. and generally round in shape.
flashcards.example: The leopard is noted for the spots of color in its fur.
flashcards.definitionZh: 物体表面上的圆形或不规则斑块，具有不同的颜色、纹理等，通常呈圆形。
flashcards.exampleZh: 豹子以其皮毛上的彩色斑点而闻名。

flashcards.definition: A party, celebration, social function.
flashcards.example: We’re having a bit of a do on Saturday to celebrate my birthday.
flashcards.definitionZh: 聚会、庆典、社交活动。
flashcards.exampleZh: 周六我们会做一些事情来庆祝我的生日。

flashcards.definition: Extremely, more than
flashcards.example: 2017 July 13, Joseph Gamp "Marvel release stirring new set images of Black Panther and we are BEYOND excited" Metro (UK)
flashcards.definitionZh: 极其，超过
flashcards.exampleZh: 2017 年 7 月 13 日，约瑟夫·甘普“漫威发布了激动人心的黑豹新片场图片，我们非常兴奋” Metro（英国）

flashcards.definition: The undomesticated state of a wild animal
flashcards.example: After mending the lion's leg, we returned him to the wild.
flashcards.definitionZh: 野生动物的未驯化状态
flashcards.exampleZh: 修好狮子的腿后，我们将他放回了野外。

flashcards.definition: Existing in or constructed from fantasy; of or relating to fantasy; fanciful.
flashcards.example: He told fantastic stories of dragons and goblins.
flashcards.definitionZh: 存在于幻想中或由幻想构建的；属于幻想或与幻想有关的；幻想的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他讲述了关于龙和妖精的奇妙故事。

flashcards.definition: The act or state of expecting or looking forward to an event as about to happen.
flashcards.example: This is the word Expectation.
flashcards.definitionZh: 期待或盼望某件事即将发生的行为或状态。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是期望这个词。

flashcards.definition: Lacking refinement, taste or delicacy.
flashcards.example: coarse language
flashcards.definitionZh: 缺乏精致、品味或精致。
flashcards.exampleZh: 粗俗的语言

flashcards.definition: A manner in which a problem is solved or policy is made.
flashcards.example: 1991, Carol Lee Johnston, Jeanne Lazaris, Plane Trigonometry, A New Approach.
flashcards.definitionZh: 解决问题或制定政策的方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 1991 年，卡罗尔·李·约翰斯顿、珍妮·拉扎里斯，平面三角学，一种新方法。

flashcards.definition: A business partnership; the name under which it trades.
flashcards.example: This is the word Firm.
flashcards.definitionZh: 商业伙伴关系；其交易名称。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是坚定这个词。

flashcards.definition: A pad on which a person can recline and sleep, usually having an inner section of coiled springs covered with foam or other cushioning material then enclosed with cloth fabric.
flashcards.example: This is the word Mattress.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种供人斜倚和睡觉的垫子，通常具有螺旋弹簧的内部部分，上面覆盖着泡沫或其他缓冲材料，然后用布料包裹。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是床垫这个词。

flashcards.definition: To hurt or sting.
flashcards.example: After being hit with a pitch, the batter exclaimed "Ouch, my arm smarts!"
flashcards.definitionZh: 伤害或刺痛。
flashcards.exampleZh: 击球手被球击中后惊呼“哎呀，我的手臂受伤了！”

flashcards.definition: To suffer decomposition due to biological action, especially by fungi or bacteria.
flashcards.example: The apple left in the cupboard all that time had started to rot.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由于生物作用，特别是真菌或细菌的作用而分解。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一直放在柜子里的苹果已经开始腐烂。

flashcards.definition: Of perishable items, overridden with bacteria and other infectious agents.
flashcards.example: If you leave a bin unattended for a few weeks, the rubbish inside will turn rotten.
flashcards.definitionZh: 易腐烂的物品，充满细菌和其他传染源。
flashcards.exampleZh: 如果你将垃圾箱无人看管几周，里面的垃圾就会腐烂。

flashcards.definition: A thin bed cloth used as a covering for a mattress or as a layer over the sleeper.
flashcards.example: Use the sheets in the hall closet to make the bed.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种薄床布，用作床垫的覆盖物或覆盖睡眠者的一层。
flashcards.exampleZh: 使用大厅壁橱里的床单来铺床。

flashcards.definition: A heavy, loosely woven fabric, usually large and woollen, used for warmth while sleeping or resting.
flashcards.example: The baby was cold, so his mother put a blanket over him.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种厚重、松散的织物，通常是大的羊毛织物，用于在睡觉或休息时保暖。
flashcards.exampleZh: 宝宝冷了，妈妈给他盖了毯子。

flashcards.definition: A beam of light or radiation.
flashcards.example: I saw a ray of light through the clouds.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一束光或辐射。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我看到一丝光透过云层。

flashcards.definition: A higher than normal body temperature of a person (or, generally, a mammal), usually caused by disease.
flashcards.example: "I have a fever. I think I've the flu."
flashcards.definitionZh: 人（或者通常是哺乳动物）的体温高于正常水平，通常由疾病引起。
flashcards.exampleZh: “我发烧了。我想我得了流感。”

flashcards.definition: One of a pair of long flat runners designed for gliding over snow or water
flashcards.example: This is the word Ski.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一对长平滑道之一，设计用于在雪或水上滑行
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是滑雪这个词。

flashcards.definition: A liquid (often thickened) condiment or accompaniment to food.
flashcards.example: apple sauce; mint sauce
flashcards.definitionZh: 液体（通常是增稠的）调味品或食物的佐料。
flashcards.exampleZh: 苹果酱；薄荷酱

flashcards.definition: A covering for a person or thing; as, a caul (especially over the head)
flashcards.example: a nun's veil
flashcards.definitionZh: 覆盖人​​或物的东西；作为，膜（尤其是在头上）
flashcards.exampleZh: 修女的面纱

flashcards.definition: The amount of bending that something undergoes when a force is applied to it; a tendency to yield under pressure; resilence.
flashcards.example: There is no give in his dogmatic religious beliefs.
flashcards.definitionZh: 当某物受力时所经历的弯曲量；在压力下有屈服的倾向；韧性。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他没有屈服于教条式的宗教信仰。

flashcards.definition: The face, often used deprecatingly.
flashcards.example: What an ugly mug.
flashcards.definitionZh: 脸，经常被贬义地使用。
flashcards.exampleZh: 多么丑陋的杯子啊。

flashcards.definition: An act of stretching.
flashcards.example: I was right in the middle of a stretch when the phone rang.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种伸展的动作。
flashcards.exampleZh: 正当我正在伸懒腰的时候，电话响了。

flashcards.definition: (with a positive sense) Focused in the pursuit of an objective; eager to obtain or do.
flashcards.example: earnest prayers
flashcards.definitionZh: （积极的）专注于追求一个目标；渴望获得或做。
flashcards.exampleZh: 恳切的祈祷

flashcards.definition: Act or instance of running, of moving rapidly using the feet.
flashcards.example: I just got back from my morning run.
flashcards.definitionZh: 跑步、用脚快速移动的动作或实例。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我刚刚晨跑回来。

flashcards.definition: On the whole; with everything considered.
flashcards.example: Altogether, I'm sorry it happened.
flashcards.definitionZh: 总体上;考虑到一切。
flashcards.exampleZh: 总而言之，我很抱歉发生了这样的事。

flashcards.definition: A person who serves as a subject for artwork or fashion, usually in the medium of photography but also for painting or drawing.
flashcards.example: The beautiful model had her face on the cover of almost every fashion magazine imaginable.
flashcards.definitionZh: 作为艺术品或时尚主题的人，通常以摄影为媒介，但也用于绘画或绘画。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这位美丽的模特几乎登上了所有可以想象到的时尚杂志的封面。

flashcards.definition: That which represents something else.
flashcards.example: The Venus of Willendorf was an early representation of the female body.
flashcards.definitionZh: 代表其他东西的东西。
flashcards.exampleZh: 维伦多夫的维纳斯是女性身体的早期代表。

flashcards.definition: A position of power or influence, or a way to get it.
flashcards.example: His parents got him an in with the company.
flashcards.definitionZh: 权力或影响力的地位，或者获得它的方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他的父母让他加入了这家公司。

flashcards.definition: To switch on
flashcards.example: Can you on the light?
flashcards.definitionZh: 开启
flashcards.exampleZh: 你能开灯吗？

flashcards.definition: An exhibition of items.
flashcards.example: art show;  dog show
flashcards.definitionZh: 物品展览。
flashcards.exampleZh: 艺术展；  狗展

flashcards.definition: Self-assurance.
flashcards.example: This is the word Confidence.
flashcards.definitionZh: 自信。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是信心这个词。

flashcards.definition: A piece of knowledge that is hidden and intended to be kept hidden.
flashcards.example: "Can you keep a secret?" "Yes." "So can I."
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种被隐藏并且旨在被隐藏的知识。
flashcards.exampleZh: “你能保守秘密吗？” “是的。” “我也可以。”

flashcards.definition: The food or money required to keep someone alive and healthy; one's support, maintenance.
flashcards.example: He works as a cobbler's apprentice for his keep.
flashcards.definitionZh: 维持某人生存和健康所需的食物或金钱；一个人的支持、维护。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他当补鞋匠的学徒以维持生计。

flashcards.definition: The state of being self-confident
flashcards.example: This is the word Self-confidence.
flashcards.definitionZh: 自信的状态
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是自信这个词。

flashcards.definition: A position of power or influence, or a way to get it.
flashcards.example: His parents got him an in with the company.
flashcards.definitionZh: 权力或影响力的地位，或者获得它的方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他的父母让他加入了这家公司。

flashcards.definition: A position of power or influence, or a way to get it.
flashcards.example: His parents got him an in with the company.
flashcards.definitionZh: 权力或影响力的地位，或者获得它的方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他的父母让他加入了这家公司。

flashcards.definition: Resistance of the air (or some other fluid) to something moving through it.
flashcards.example: When designing cars, manufacturers have to take drag into consideration.
flashcards.definitionZh: 空气（或其他液体）对穿过其中的物体的阻力。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在设计汽车时，制造商必须考虑阻力。

flashcards.definition: Of use as a metaphor, simile, or metonym, as opposed to literal; using figures; as when saying that someone who eats more than they should is a pig or like a pig.
flashcards.example: This is the word Figurative.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用作隐喻、明喻或转喻，与字面意思相反；使用数字；就像说吃得过多的人是猪或像猪一样。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是比喻这个词。

flashcards.definition: To have conviction in (something said or expressed); to be sincere in (what one says).
flashcards.example: Does she really mean what she said to him last night?
flashcards.definitionZh: 对（所说或表达的东西）有信念；真诚地对待（某人所说的话）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她昨晚对他说的话真的是认真的吗？

flashcards.definition: (interrogative) Which ever; emphatic form of 'which'.
flashcards.example: These chocolates all look delicious. Whichever shall I choose?
flashcards.definitionZh: （疑问）无论哪一个； “which”的强调形式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这些巧克力看起来都很好吃。我该选哪一个呢？

flashcards.definition: A person of low general intelligence.
flashcards.example: This is the word Idiot.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一般智力低下的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是白痴这个词。

flashcards.definition: A form of military insignia.
flashcards.example: I just got my first commando flash.
flashcards.definitionZh: 军事徽章的一种形式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我刚刚拿到了我的第一个突击队闪光灯。

flashcards.definition: A storm consisting of thunder and lightning produced by a cumulonimbus, usually accompanied with heavy rain, wind, and sometimes hail; and in rarer cases sleet, freezing rain, or snow.
flashcards.example: This is the word Thunderstorm.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由积雨云产生的雷电风暴，通常伴有大雨、大风，有时还伴有冰雹；极少数情况下会出现雨夹雪、冻雨或雪。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是雷雨这个词。

flashcards.definition: An optical or other representation of a real object; a graphic; a picture.
flashcards.example: The Bible forbids the worship of graven images.
flashcards.definitionZh: 真实物体的光学或其他表示；图形；一张照片。
flashcards.exampleZh: 圣经禁止崇拜雕刻的图像。

flashcards.definition: (of a radio, TV, telephone, internet, etc.) An electromagnetic action, normally a voltage that is a function of time, that conveys the information of the radio or TV program or of communication with another party.
flashcards.example: My mobile phone can't get a signal in the railway station.
flashcards.definitionZh: （收音机、电视、电话、互联网等）一种电磁作用，通常是作为时间函数的电压，用于传达广播或电视节目或与另一方通信的信息。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我的手机在火车站收不到信号。

flashcards.definition: An item of play equipment that children can climb up and then slide down again.
flashcards.example: The long, red slide was great fun for the kids.
flashcards.definitionZh: 儿童可以爬上去然后再滑下来的游乐设施。
flashcards.exampleZh: 红色的长滑梯对孩子们来说非常有趣。

flashcards.definition: A thin, slippery mix of clay and water.
flashcards.example: This is the word Slip.
flashcards.definitionZh: 粘土和水的稀薄、光滑的混合物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“滑”字。

flashcards.definition: The property of a word of sounding like what it represents.
flashcards.example: This is the word Onomatopoeia.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个词的属性是听起来像它所代表的东西。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是象声词。

flashcards.definition: A sudden, intense, loud sound, as made for example by cymbals.
flashcards.example: After the lightning came the crash of thunder.
flashcards.definitionZh: 突然、强烈、响亮的声音，例如铙钹发出的声音。
flashcards.exampleZh: 闪电过后，便是雷霆轰鸣。

flashcards.definition: A crowd that produces uncomfortable pressure.
flashcards.example: a crush at a reception
flashcards.definitionZh: 产生不舒服压力的人群。
flashcards.exampleZh: 接待处的暗恋

flashcards.definition: The sound made by an object hitting a liquid.
flashcards.example: I heard a splash when the rock landed in the pond.
flashcards.definitionZh: 物体撞击液体时发出的声音。
flashcards.exampleZh: 当石头落入池塘时，我听到扑通一声。

flashcards.definition: An object round and gently curved (shaped like a saucer).
flashcards.example: The saucer-shaped object could have been a UFO.
flashcards.definitionZh: 圆形且轻微弯曲的物体（形状像碟子）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这个碟形物体可能是一个不明飞行物。

flashcards.definition: A cloth used to cover and protect a table, especially for a dining table.
flashcards.example: This is the word Tablecloth.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用于覆盖和保护桌子，特别是餐桌的布。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是桌布这个词。

flashcards.definition: An aggregation of data on a storage device, identified by a name.
flashcards.example: I'm going to delete these unwanted files to free up some disk space.
flashcards.definitionZh: 存储设备上的数据聚合，由名称标识。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我将删除这些不需要的文件以释放一些磁盘空间。

flashcards.definition: To perceive the truth or factuality of; to be certain of or that.
flashcards.example: He knew something terrible was going to happen.
flashcards.definitionZh: 感知以下事实的真相或事实；确定或那个。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他知道将会发生可怕的事情。

flashcards.definition: To sink away; to disappear gradually; to grow dim; to vanish.
flashcards.example: The milkman's whistling faded into the distance.
flashcards.definitionZh: 沉没；逐渐消失；变得暗淡；消失。
flashcards.exampleZh: 送奶工的口哨声渐渐消失在远方。

flashcards.definition: All the electromagnetic radiation given off by the Sun, especially that in the visible spectrum that bathes the Earth.
flashcards.example: Sunlight on the skin gives you vitamin D.
flashcards.definitionZh: 太阳发出的所有电磁辐射，尤其是覆盖地球的可见光谱中的电磁辐射。
flashcards.exampleZh: 皮肤上的阳光可以为您提供维生素 D。

flashcards.definition: A party, celebration, social function.
flashcards.example: We’re having a bit of a do on Saturday to celebrate my birthday.
flashcards.definitionZh: 聚会、庆典、社交活动。
flashcards.exampleZh: 周六我们会做一些事情来庆祝我的生日。

flashcards.definition: An operation that reverses a previous action.
flashcards.example: How many undos does this program support?
flashcards.definitionZh: 反转先前操作的操作。
flashcards.exampleZh: 该程序支持多少次撤消？

flashcards.definition: Not done.
flashcards.example: This is the word Undone.
flashcards.definitionZh: 没有完成。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“未完成”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Zero; nothing.
flashcards.example: I know zip about economics.
flashcards.definitionZh: 零;没有什么。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我对经济学了解甚多。

flashcards.definition: A looping of a piece of string or of any other long, flexible material that cannot be untangled without passing one or both ends of the material through its loops.
flashcards.example: Climbers must make sure that all knots are both secure and of types that will not weaken the rope.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一根绳子或任何其他长的柔性材料的环，如果材料的一端或两端不穿过其环，则无法解开。
flashcards.exampleZh: 登山者必须确保所有结都牢固且不会削弱绳索的类型。

flashcards.definition: To get back; to recover possession of.
flashcards.example: This is the word Regain.
flashcards.definitionZh: 回来；恢复占有。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“重获新生”这个词。

flashcards.definition: The state of being conscious or aware; awareness.
flashcards.example: This is the word Consciousness.
flashcards.definitionZh: 有意识或有意识的状态；意识。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是意识这个词。

flashcards.definition: To use up.
flashcards.example: The power plant consumes 30 tons of coal per hour.
flashcards.definitionZh: 要用尽。
flashcards.exampleZh: 该发电厂每小时消耗30吨煤。

flashcards.definition: To express approval (of something) by clapping the hands.
flashcards.example: After the performance, the audience applauded for five minutes.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过拍手来表达（对某事）的认可。
flashcards.exampleZh: 演出结束后，观众报以长达五分钟的掌声。

flashcards.definition: The act of applauding; approbation and praise publicly expressed by the clapping of hands, stamping or tapping of the feet, acclamation, huzzas, or other means; marked commendation.
flashcards.example: This is the word Applause.
flashcards.definitionZh: 鼓掌的动作；通过拍手、跺脚、拍脚、鼓掌、欢呼或其他方式公开表达认可和赞扬；显着表扬。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是掌声这个词。

flashcards.definition: The act of striking the palms of the hands, or any two surfaces, together.
flashcards.example: He summoned the waiter with a clap.
flashcards.definitionZh: 将手掌或任何两个表面敲在一起的动作。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他拍手叫来了服务员。

flashcards.definition: To skate on rollerblades.
flashcards.example: Want to go blading with me later in the park?
flashcards.definitionZh: 用旱冰鞋滑冰。
flashcards.exampleZh: 稍后想和我一起去公园玩滑冰吗？

flashcards.definition: To accept responsibility for.
flashcards.example: shoulder the blame
flashcards.definitionZh: 承担责任。
flashcards.exampleZh: 承担责任

flashcards.definition: A bottle stopper made from this or any other material.
flashcards.example: Snobs feel it's hard to call it wine with a straight face when the cork is made of plastic.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由这种材料或任何其他材料制成的瓶塞。
flashcards.exampleZh: 势利小人认为，当软木塞是塑料制成的时，很难板着脸称其为葡萄酒。

flashcards.definition: An implement for opening bottles that are sealed by a cork. Sometimes specifically such an implement that includes a screw-shaped part, or worm.
flashcards.example: I opened the wine with a corkscrew.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种用于打开用软木塞密封的瓶子的工具。有时，具体地，这样的工具包括螺旋形部件或蜗杆。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我用开瓶器打开了酒。

flashcards.definition: To move something from one place to another, especially to take away.
flashcards.example: He removed the marbles from the bag.
flashcards.definitionZh: 将某物从一处移至另一处，尤指拿走。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他从袋子里取出弹珠。

flashcards.definition: Motivation to do or achieve something; ability coupled with ambition.
flashcards.example: Crassus had wealth and wit, but Pompey had drive and Caesar as much again.
flashcards.definitionZh: 做某事或取得某事的动机；能力加上野心。
flashcards.exampleZh: 克拉苏拥有财富和智慧，但庞培和凯撒同样拥有动力。

flashcards.definition: (plural staff or staffs) The employees of a business.
flashcards.example: The company employed 10 new members of staff this month.
flashcards.definitionZh: （复数员工或员工）企业的员工。
flashcards.exampleZh: 该公司本月雇用了 10 名新员工。

flashcards.definition: Bad-mannered.
flashcards.example: Karen broke up with Fred because he was often rude to her.
flashcards.definitionZh: 没礼貌。
flashcards.exampleZh: 凯伦与弗雷德分手，因为他经常对她无礼。

flashcards.definition: The software and/or hardware existing on any particular computer system.
flashcards.example: That program uses the Microsoft Windows environment.
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何特定计算机系统上存在的软件和/或硬件。
flashcards.exampleZh: 该程序使用 Microsoft Windows 环境。

flashcards.definition: (usually in plural) An instance or cause of unhappiness.
flashcards.example: Parting is such sweet sorrow.
flashcards.definitionZh: （通常为复数）不快乐的事例或原因。
flashcards.exampleZh: 离别是多么甜蜜的悲伤。

flashcards.definition: A drama or similar work, in which the main character is brought to ruin or otherwise suffers the extreme consequences of some tragic flaw or weakness of character.
flashcards.example: This is the word Tragedy.
flashcards.definitionZh: 戏剧或类似的作品，其中主角被毁掉或遭受某些悲剧性缺陷或性格弱点的极端后果。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是悲剧这个词。

flashcards.definition: Affectionate.
flashcards.example: a fond farewell
flashcards.definitionZh: 亲热。
flashcards.exampleZh: 深情的告别

flashcards.definition: To lay carpet, or to have carpet installed, in an area.
flashcards.example: After the fire, they carpeted over the blackened hardwood flooring.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在某个区域铺设地毯或安装地毯。
flashcards.exampleZh: 火灾发生后，他们在变黑的硬木地板上铺了地毯。

flashcards.definition: A partial covering for a floor.
flashcards.example: This is the word RUG.
flashcards.definitionZh: 地板的部分覆盖物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“地毯”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A flat piece of coarse material used for wiping one’s feet, or as a decorative or protective floor covering.
flashcards.example: Wipe your feet on the mat before coming in.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一块扁平的粗糙材料，用于擦脚，或作为装饰或保护性地板覆盖物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 进来之前先在垫子上擦脚。

flashcards.definition: (of fruits, vegetables, seeds etc.) Ready for reaping or gathering; having attained perfection; mature
flashcards.example: ripe apples
flashcards.definitionZh: （水果、蔬菜、种子等）准备收割或采集的；已经达到完美；成熟
flashcards.exampleZh: 成熟的苹果

flashcards.definition: Not ripe.

flashcards.definition: To act as a clerk, to perform the duties or functions of a clerk

flashcards.definition: Removal or expulsion from a group or activity

flashcards.definition: To quit (a job or position).

flashcards.definition: To shake, quiver, or vibrate.

flashcards.definition: A trench; a long, shallow indentation, as for irrigation or drainage.

flashcards.definition: A type of pastry that consists of an outer crust and a filling.

flashcards.definitionZh: 由面粉和脂肪糊制成的烘焙食品，例如馅饼皮；还有蛋挞、熊爪、拿破仑、酥皮等。

flashcards.definitionZh: 针对个人、机构或团体因某些指控或认为的伤害或不公正行为而采取的任何形式的个人报复行为。

flashcards.definition: To pay back.

flashcards.definitionZh: 去偿还。

flashcards.definition: Something that is immoral or not good.

flashcards.definitionZh: 不道德或不好的事情。
flashcards.exampleZh: 不公正是令人发指的错误。

flashcards.definition: To do enough for; to meet the needs of; to fulfill the wishes or requirements of.

flashcards.definitionZh: 做足够的事；满足以下需求；以满足……的愿望或要求。

flashcards.definition: (of a course of action) Worthy of being recommended; desirable.

flashcards.definition: To raise (someone) to a more important, responsible, or remunerative job or rank.

flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“收入”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Any interconnected group or system

flashcards.definition: The trunk of a dead tree, cleared of branches.

flashcards.definition: A word used to gain admittance or to gain access to information; watchword.

flashcards.definition: A body of one or more persons convened for the accomplishment of some specific purpose, typically with formal protocols.

flashcards.definition: Of, relating to, or enacted by a parliament

flashcards.definition: A sudden, usually noisy expulsion of air from the lungs, often involuntary.

flashcards.definitionZh: 肺部突然、通常有噪音地排出空气，通常是不自觉的。

flashcards.definition: Something of value given in return for an act.

flashcards.definition: A material for gun barrels, consisting of iron and steel twisted and welded together.

flashcards.exampleZh: 他检查了犯罪现场寻找线索。

flashcards.definition: A container made of rigid material, often with a handle, used to carry liquids or small items.
flashcards.example: I need a bucket to carry the water from the well.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由刚性材料制成的容器，通常带有手柄，用于携带液体或小物品。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我需要一个桶来从井里提水。

flashcards.definition: A device, command, or feature which allows someone to achieve a specific task.
flashcards.example: This game has a mechanic where if you run toward a ledge you automatically jump off rather than just falling.
flashcards.definitionZh: 允许某人完成特定任务的设备、命令或功能。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这个游戏有一个机制，如果你跑向壁架，你会自动跳下来，而不是直接掉下来。

flashcards.definition: Related to mechanics (the branch of physics that deals with forces acting on mass).
flashcards.example: mechanical engineering
flashcards.definitionZh: 与力学（处理作用于质量的力的物理学分支）相关。
flashcards.exampleZh: 机械工业

flashcards.definition: To take cover.
flashcards.example: During the rainstorm, we sheltered under a tree.
flashcards.definitionZh: 寻找掩护。
flashcards.exampleZh: 暴雨期间，我们躲在一棵树下。

flashcards.definition: A method or means by which something may be accomplished.
flashcards.example: There are several avenues by which we can approach this problem.
flashcards.definitionZh: 可以完成某事的方法或手段。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们可以通过多种途径来解决这个问题。

flashcards.definition: The extent or measure of how broad or wide something is.
flashcards.example: This is the word Breadth.
flashcards.definitionZh: 某事物的范围或范围有多广或宽广的程度。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是广度这个词。

flashcards.definition: A group of objects held together by wrapping or tying.
flashcards.example: a bundle of straw or of paper; a bundle of old clothes
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过包裹或绑扎在一起的一组物体。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一捆稻草或纸；一捆旧衣服

flashcards.definition: In any case. Used to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous statement.
flashcards.example: Anyhow, he is dead now.
flashcards.definitionZh: 无论如何。用于表示某个陈述解释或支持先前的陈述。
flashcards.exampleZh: 无论如何，他现在已经死了。

flashcards.definition: To cut (something) with a saw.
flashcards.example: They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;
flashcards.definitionZh: 用锯子切割（某物）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他们被石头打死，被锯开，被试探，被刀剑杀害；他们披着绵羊皮和山羊皮四处游荡；贫穷、受苦、受折磨；

flashcards.definition: The act, quality, or condition of being honest.
flashcards.example: academic / artistic / emotional / intellectual honesty
flashcards.definitionZh: 诚实的行为、品质或条件。
flashcards.exampleZh: 学术/艺术/情感/智力诚实

flashcards.definition: The characteristic or condition of being dishonest.
flashcards.example: This is the word Dishonesty.
flashcards.definitionZh: 不诚实的特征或状况。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是不诚实这个词。

flashcards.definition: A seasonal home of any size or stature, a recreational home or a home in a remote location.
flashcards.example: Most cottages in the area were larger and more elaborate than my home.
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何规模或高度的季节性住宅、休闲住宅或偏远地区的住宅。
flashcards.exampleZh: 该地区的大多数小屋都比我家更大、更精致。

flashcards.definition: The quality produced by the sensation of taste or, especially, of taste and smell in combined effect.
flashcards.example: The flavor of this apple pie is delicious.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由味觉或特别是味觉和嗅觉共同作用产生的品质。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这个苹果派的味道很好吃。

flashcards.definition: To put out a team for a match.
flashcards.example: Milton Keynes have yet to ice a team this season
flashcards.definitionZh: 派出一支球队参加比赛。
flashcards.exampleZh: 米尔顿凯恩斯本赛季还没有为球队效力

flashcards.definition: (by extension) Any reward of victory or mark of honor.
flashcards.example: the martyr's crown
flashcards.definitionZh: （引申为）任何胜利奖励或荣誉标志。
flashcards.exampleZh: 烈士的王冠

flashcards.definition: The hairy coat of various mammal species, especially when fine, soft and thick.
flashcards.example: This is the word Fur.
flashcards.definitionZh: 各种哺乳动物的毛茸茸的皮毛，尤其是细密、柔软和厚实的皮毛。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是毛皮这个词。

flashcards.definition: To sharpen by rubbing on a strap, or strop
flashcards.example: to strap a razor
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过在带子或带子上摩擦来磨锐
flashcards.exampleZh: 绑剃须刀

flashcards.definition: A watch that is worn on a strap or band fastened around the wrist
flashcards.example: This is the word Wristwatch.
flashcards.definitionZh: 佩戴在手腕上的表带或带子上的手表
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是手表这个词。

flashcards.definition: To furnish with cushions.
flashcards.example: to cushion a sofa
flashcards.definitionZh: 配备垫子。
flashcards.exampleZh: 给沙发加垫子

flashcards.definition: An instance of drawing something into one's mouth by inhaling.
flashcards.example: This is the word Suck.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过吸气将某物吸入口中的实例。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是吸这个词。

flashcards.definition: Remarkably good.
flashcards.example: an extraordinary poet
flashcards.definitionZh: 非常好。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一位非凡的诗人

flashcards.definition: Destiny; often with a connotation of death, ruin, misfortune, etc.
flashcards.example: Accept your fate.
flashcards.definitionZh: 命运;通常带有死亡、毁灭、不幸等含义。
flashcards.exampleZh: 接受你的命运。

flashcards.definition: A group of individuals chosen from the general population to hear and decide a case in a court of law.
flashcards.example: This is the word Jury.
flashcards.definitionZh: 从普通民众中选出的一群人，在法庭上审理和裁决案件。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是陪审团这个词。

flashcards.definition: A position of power or influence, or a way to get it.
flashcards.example: His parents got him an in with the company.
flashcards.definitionZh: 权力或影响力的地位，或者获得它的方式。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他的父母让他加入了这家公司。

flashcards.definition: The amount, number or rate of something, regarded as part of a total of 100; a part of a whole.
flashcards.example: A high percentage of secondary school leavers take a gap year.
flashcards.definitionZh: 某物的金额、数量或比例，被视为总计 100 的一部分；整体的一部分。
flashcards.exampleZh: 很大比例的中学毕业生会选择间隔年。

flashcards.definition: For each.
flashcards.example: $2.50 per dozen
flashcards.definitionZh: 对于每一个。
flashcards.exampleZh: 每打 2.50 美元

flashcards.definition: A single action of sweeping.
flashcards.example: Give the front steps a quick sweep to get rid of those fallen leaves.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个简单的扫地动作。
flashcards.exampleZh: 快速清扫前面的台阶，清除那些落叶。

flashcards.definition: A domestic utensil with fibers bound together at the end of a long handle, used for sweeping.
flashcards.example: This is the word Broom.
flashcards.definitionZh: 长柄末端有纤维粘合在一起的家用器具，用于扫地。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是扫帚这个词。

flashcards.definition: The amount swallowed in one gulp; the act of swallowing.
flashcards.example: He took the aspirin with a single swallow of water.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一口气吞下的量；吞咽的动作。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他吞下一口水服用了阿司匹林。

flashcards.definition: To be unable to breathe because of obstruction of the windpipe (for instance food or other objects that go down the wrong way, or fumes or particles in the air that cause the throat to constrict).
flashcards.example: Ever since he choked on a bone, he has refused to eat fish.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由于气管阻塞而无法呼吸（例如食物或其他物体进入错误的方向，或者空气中的烟雾或颗粒导致喉咙收缩）。
flashcards.exampleZh: 自从被骨头噎住后，他就不再吃鱼了。

flashcards.definition: A little bit.
flashcards.example: He didn't feel even an ounce of regret for his actions.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一点点。
flashcards.exampleZh: 对于自己的行为，他没有半点后悔。

flashcards.definition: Any of various units of currency formerly used in the United States.
flashcards.example: the Rhode Island pound; the New Hampshire pound
flashcards.definitionZh: 以前在美国使用的任何各种货币单位。
flashcards.exampleZh: 罗德岛镑；新罕布什尔镑

flashcards.definition: The central part of some fruits, particularly drupes; consisting of the seed and a hard endocarp layer.
flashcards.example: a peach stone
flashcards.definitionZh: 一些水果的中心部分，特别是核果；由种子和坚硬的内果皮层组成。
flashcards.exampleZh: 一颗桃核

flashcards.definition: A large amount.
flashcards.example: I've got tons of work to do.
flashcards.definitionZh: 数量很大。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我有很多工作要做。

flashcards.definition: In the International System of Units, the base unit of mass; conceived of as the mass of one litre of water, but now defined by taking the fixed numerical value of the Planck constant h to be 6.626 070 15 × 10-34 when expressed in units of kg⋅m2⋅s−1. Symbol: kg
flashcards.example: This is the word Kilogram kilo.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在国际单位制中，质量的基本单位；被认为是一升水的质量，但现在通过将普朗克常数 h 的固定数值取为 6.626 070 15 × 10-34（以 kg⋅m2⋅s−1 为单位表示）来定义。符号：公斤
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“千克”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A large amount.
flashcards.example: I've got tons of work to do.
flashcards.definitionZh: 数量很大。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我有很多工作要做。

flashcards.definition: To fail to care for or attend to something.
flashcards.example: to neglect duty or business;  to neglect to pay debts
flashcards.definitionZh: 未能关心或关注某事。
flashcards.exampleZh: 玩忽职守或玩忽职守；  忽视偿还债务

flashcards.definition: To deteriorate, to get worse, to lose strength or health, to decline in quality.
flashcards.example: The pair loved to take pictures in the decaying hospital on forty-third street.
flashcards.definitionZh: 恶化，变得更糟，失去力量或健康，质量下降。
flashcards.exampleZh: 两人喜欢在四十三街那座破旧的医院里拍照。

flashcards.definition: The proportional relationship between one amount, value etc. and another.
flashcards.example: At the height of his powers, he was producing pictures at the rate of four a year.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个数量、价值等与另一个之间的比例关系。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在他的巅峰时期，他以每年四张的速度制作影片。

flashcards.definition: The quality of being patient.
flashcards.example: This is the word Patience.
flashcards.definitionZh: 耐心的品质。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是耐心这个词。

flashcards.definition: (grammar) The noun or noun phrase that is semantically on the receiving end of a verb's action.
flashcards.example: The subject of a passive verb is usually a patient.
flashcards.definitionZh: （语法）在语义上位于动词动作接收端的名词或名词短语。
flashcards.exampleZh: 被动动词的主语通常是病人。

flashcards.definition: Prompted by, or exhibiting, impatience.
flashcards.example: impatient speeches or replies
flashcards.definitionZh: 因不耐烦而引起或表现出不耐烦。
flashcards.exampleZh: 不耐烦的讲话或答复

flashcards.definition: To renew or revitalize.
flashcards.example: Sleep refreshes the body and the mind.
flashcards.definitionZh: 更新或恢复活力。
flashcards.exampleZh: 睡眠可以使身体和精神焕发活力。

flashcards.definition: The action of refreshing; a means of restoring strength, energy or vigour.
flashcards.example: This is the word Refreshment.
flashcards.definitionZh: 提神醒脑的作用；恢复体力、精力或活力的一种方法。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“茶点”这个词。

flashcards.definition: In writing and printing, a mark indicating the place and nature of an arrest of voice in reading; a punctuation mark.
flashcards.example: Teach the pupil to mind the pauses.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在书写和印刷中，指示阅读时停声的位置和性质的标记；标点符号。
flashcards.exampleZh: 教导学生注意停顿。

flashcards.definition: Anything precious or valuable.
flashcards.example: Galveston was the jewel of Texas prior to the hurricane.
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何珍贵或有价值的东西。
flashcards.exampleZh: 飓风发生前，加尔维斯顿是德克萨斯州的明珠。

flashcards.definition: Collectively, personal ornamentation such as rings, necklaces, brooches and bracelets, made of precious metals and sometimes set with gemstones.
flashcards.example: She had more jewellery ornamented about her than any three ladies needed.
flashcards.definitionZh: 个人装饰品的总称，如戒指、项链、胸针和手镯，由贵金属制成，有时镶嵌宝石。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她身上装饰的珠宝比任何三位女士都需要的还要多。

flashcards.definition: To give delight to; to affect with great pleasure; to please highly.
flashcards.example: A beautiful landscape delights the eye.
flashcards.definitionZh: 使人高兴；非常高兴地影响；高度取悦。
flashcards.exampleZh: 美丽的风景令人赏心悦目。

flashcards.definition: Pleasant; pleasing, bringing enjoyment, satisfaction, or pleasure.
flashcards.example: This is the word Delightful.
flashcards.definitionZh: 令人愉快的;令人愉快的，带来享受、满足或快乐。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是令人愉快的词。

flashcards.definition: A pressing; a force applied to a surface.
flashcards.example: Apply pressure to the wound to stop the bleeding.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个紧迫；施加到表面的力。
flashcards.exampleZh: 对伤口施加压力以止血。

flashcards.definition: A state of being away or withdrawn from a place or from companionship; the period of being away.
flashcards.example: Absence makes the heart grow fonder.
flashcards.definitionZh: 离开某个地方或远离某个地方或远离陪伴的状态；离开的时期。
flashcards.exampleZh: 缺席使心变得更亲近。

flashcards.definition: The act or an instance of repeating or being repeated.
flashcards.example: This is the word Repetition.
flashcards.definitionZh: 重复或被重复的行为或实例。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是重复这个词。

flashcards.definition: Yes; certainly; expression indicating strong agreement.
flashcards.example:
Do you want a free cookie with that coffee?
Absolutely!
flashcards.definitionZh: 是的;当然;表示强烈同意的表达。
flashcards.exampleZh:
您想要免费的饼干和咖啡吗？
绝对地！

flashcards.definition: The series of bones situated at the back from the head to the pelvis of a person, or from the head to the tail of an animal; backbone, vertebral column.
flashcards.example: This is the word Spine.
flashcards.definitionZh: 位于人的头部到骨盆或动物的头部到尾部的一系列骨头；脊椎，脊柱。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是脊柱这个词。

flashcards.definition: Any fundamental support, structure, or infrastructure.
flashcards.example: Before automobiles, railroads were a backbone of commerce.
flashcards.definitionZh: 任何基本的支持、结构或基础设施。
flashcards.exampleZh: 在汽车出现之前，铁路是商业的支柱。

flashcards.definition: Act or instance of running, of moving rapidly using the feet.
flashcards.example: I just got back from my morning run.
flashcards.definitionZh: 跑步、用脚快速移动的动作或实例。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我刚刚晨跑回来。

flashcards.definition: To determine the value of something or the solution to something by a mathematical process.
flashcards.example: Calculate the square root of 3 to 10 decimal places.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过数学过程确定某事物的价值或某事物的解决方案。
flashcards.exampleZh: 计算小数点后 3 到 10 位的平方根。

flashcards.definition: An artificial waterway or artificially improved river used for travel, shipping, or irrigation.
flashcards.example: This is the word Canal.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用于旅行、航运或灌溉的人工水道或人工改良的河流。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是运河这个词。

flashcards.definition: Created by people, as opposed to occurring in nature; artificial or synthetic.
flashcards.example: This is the word Man-made.
flashcards.definitionZh: 由人类创造，而不是自然发生；人工的或合成的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是人造这个词。

flashcards.definition: The cost of sending an item or package via postal services.
flashcards.example: The shipping' is included in the quoted price.
flashcards.definitionZh: 通过邮政服务发送物品或包裹的费用。
flashcards.exampleZh: 运费已包含在报价中。

flashcards.definition: Money and wealth. The means to acquire goods and services, especially in a non-barter system.
flashcards.example: He does not have enough capital to start a business.
flashcards.definitionZh: 金钱和财富。获取商品和服务的手段，尤其是在非易货贸易系统中。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他没有足够的资金来创业。

flashcards.definition: To follow as a model or a pattern; to make a copy, counterpart or semblance of.
flashcards.example: This is the word Imitate.
flashcards.definitionZh: 作为榜样或模式来遵循；制作副本、副本或类似物。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是模仿这个词。

flashcards.definition: An adult. (used especially by children)
flashcards.example: This is the word Grown-up.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一个成年人。 （特别适合儿童使用）
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“长大”这个词。

flashcards.definition: Immense extent or expanse; immensity
flashcards.example: This is the word Immense.
flashcards.definitionZh: 巨大的范围或范围；巨大
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是“巨大”这个词。

flashcards.definition: A feeling of extreme happiness or cheerfulness, especially related to the acquisition or expectation of something good.
flashcards.example: They will be a source of strength and joy in your life.
flashcards.definitionZh: 一种极度幸福或快乐的感觉，尤其与获得或期待美好事物有关。
flashcards.exampleZh: 它们将成为您生活中力量和欢乐的源泉。

flashcards.definition: To throw and catch each object at least twice.
flashcards.example: to qualify seven balls you need at least fourteen catches
flashcards.definitionZh: 每个物体至少投掷和接住两次。
flashcards.exampleZh: 要获得七个球的资格，您需要至少十四次接球

flashcards.definition: Characterized by solemn religious ceremony or religious use, especially, in a positive sense; consecrated, made holy.
flashcards.example: a sacred day
flashcards.definitionZh: 以庄严的宗教仪式或宗教用途为特征，特别是在积极意义上；被祝圣，成为圣洁。
flashcards.exampleZh: 神圣的一天

flashcards.definition: The destruction or surrender of anything for the sake of something else; the devotion of something desirable to something higher, or to a calling deemed more pressing.
flashcards.example: the sacrifice of one's spare time in order to volunteer
flashcards.definitionZh: 为了其他事物而破坏或放弃任何事物；对某些令人向往的事物的奉献精神是对更高层次的事物或对更紧迫的使命的奉献。
flashcards.exampleZh: 为了做志愿者而牺牲自己的业余时间

flashcards.definition: A very short period of time; a moment.
flashcards.example: She paused for only an instant, which was just enough time for John to change the subject.
flashcards.definitionZh: 很短的一段时间；一会儿。
flashcards.exampleZh: 她只停顿了一会儿，刚好够约翰转移话题的时间。

flashcards.definition: To decorate.
flashcards.example: We will ornament the windows with trim to make the room seem brighter.
flashcards.definitionZh: 装饰。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我们会用饰条装饰窗户，使房间看起来更明亮。

flashcards.definition: Wholly; really, completely.
flashcards.example: This is the word Purely.
flashcards.definitionZh: 完全；真的，完全地。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是纯粹这个词。

flashcards.definition: The state or degree of being pure.
flashcards.example: This is the word Purity.
flashcards.definitionZh: 纯净的状态或程度。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是纯洁这个词。

flashcards.definition: The condition of being impure; because of contamination, pollution, adulteration or insufficient purification.
flashcards.example: Even animals in the Jewish system cause impurity only when they are dead.
flashcards.definitionZh: 不纯洁的状况；由于污染、污染、掺假或净化不充分。
flashcards.exampleZh: 即使是犹太体系中的动物，只有在死后才会造成不洁。

flashcards.definition: To examine or investigate something systematically.
flashcards.example: The committee has been exploring alternative solutions to the problem at hand.
flashcards.definitionZh: 系统地检查或调查某事。
flashcards.exampleZh: 该委员会一直在探索当前问题的替代解决方案。

flashcards.definition: Our universe, the sum of everything that exists in the cosmos, including time and space itself.
flashcards.example: Powerful telescopes look far back into the distant reaches of the Universe.
flashcards.definitionZh: 我们的宇宙，是宇宙中存在的一切事物的总和，包括时间和空间本身。
flashcards.exampleZh: 强大的望远镜可以遥望遥远的宇宙。

flashcards.definition: (followed by "of") to charge with having committed a crime or offence
flashcards.example: For the U.S. President to be impeached, he must be accused of a high crime or misdemeanor.
flashcards.definitionZh: （后跟“of”）指控犯有犯罪或违法行为
flashcards.exampleZh: 美国总统要被弹劾，他必须被指控犯有重罪或轻罪。

flashcards.definition: The act of distinguishing, discriminating; discrimination.
flashcards.example: There is a distinction to be made between resting and slacking.
flashcards.definitionZh: 区分、歧视的行为；歧视。
flashcards.exampleZh: 休息和懈怠是有区别的。

flashcards.definition: Government policy or (infra)structure related to the military.
flashcards.example: Department of Defence
flashcards.definitionZh: 与军事相关的政府政策或（基础设施）结构。
flashcards.exampleZh: 国防部

flashcards.definition: A literary piece written in verse.
flashcards.example: This is the word Poem.
flashcards.definitionZh: 用诗歌写成的文学作品。

flashcards.definitionZh: 用杆推动，用杆推动。

flashcards.definition: Precise or very accurate.

flashcards.definitionZh: 精确或非常精确。
flashcards.exampleZh: 该建筑在一次外科手术式的空袭中被摧毁。

flashcards.definition: An elastic material used in clothing, particularly in waistbands and cuffs.
flashcards.example: running shorts use elastic to eliminate the need for a belt
flashcards.definitionZh: 用于服装的弹性材料，特别是腰带和袖口。
flashcards.exampleZh: 跑步短裤采用松紧带，无需系腰带

flashcards.definition: To mentally support; to motivate, give courage, hope or spirit.
flashcards.example: I encouraged him during his race.
flashcards.definitionZh: 精神上的支持；激励、给予勇气、希望或精神。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我在比赛期间鼓励他。

flashcards.definition: To extinguish the courage of; to dishearten; to depress the spirits of; to deprive of confidence; to deject.
flashcards.example: Don't be discouraged by the amount of work left to do: you'll finish it in good time.
flashcards.definitionZh: 消灭……的勇气；使灰心丧气；使精神沮丧；剥夺信心；沮丧。
flashcards.exampleZh: 不要因为还有大量的工作要做而灰心：你会及时完成它的。

flashcards.definition: Having or showing grace in movement, shape, or proportion.
flashcards.example: She is a graceful dancer.
flashcards.definitionZh: 在动作、形状或比例上具有或表现出优雅。

flashcards.definition: The condition of being free from control or restrictions.
flashcards.example: The army is here, your liberty is assured.
flashcards.definitionZh: 不受控制或限制的状态。
flashcards.exampleZh: 军队来了，你的自由有保障。

flashcards.definition: A stick with a flame on one end, used chiefly as a light source; a similarly shaped implement with a replaceable supply of flammable material.

flashcards.definitionZh: 一端有火焰的棍子，主要用作光源；具有可更换易燃材料供应的类似形状的工具。

flashcards.definition: To provoke someone to do wrong, especially by promising a reward; to entice.

flashcards.definitionZh: 挑衅某人做错事，尤其是承诺奖励；去引诱。

flashcards.definition: A domestic animal, Equus asinus asinus, similar to a horse

flashcards.exampleZh: 这是驴这个词。

flashcards.definition: Someone who guides, especially someone hired to show people around a place or an institution and offer information and explanation.

flashcards.definitionZh: 提供指导的人，尤其是受雇带人们参观一个地方或一个机构并提供信息和解释的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 导游带领我们参观了博物馆并讲解了展品。

flashcards.definition: A person who is qualified or professionally engaged in any branch of engineering.
flashcards.example: This is the word Engineer.
flashcards.definitionZh: 具有资格或专业从事任何工程领域的人员。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是工程师这个词。

flashcards.definition: Appreciative; thankful.
flashcards.example: I'm grateful that you helped me out.
flashcards.definitionZh: 欣赏；感恩。
flashcards.exampleZh: 我很感激你帮助了我。

flashcards.definition: Requiring immediate attention.
flashcards.example: An urgent appeal was sent out for assistance.
flashcards.definitionZh: 需要立即关注。
flashcards.exampleZh: 已发出紧急呼吁寻求援助。

flashcards.definition: To destroy with an explosion.

flashcards.definitionZh: 用爆炸来摧毁。
flashcards.exampleZh: 刺客用汽车炸弹炸毁了汽车。

flashcards.definition: Of high value or worth.
flashcards.example: The crown had many precious gemstones.   This building work needs site access, and tell the city council that I don't care about a few lorry tyre ruts across their precious grass verge.
flashcards.definitionZh: 具有较高的价值或价值。
flashcards.exampleZh: 王冠上镶嵌着许多珍贵的宝石。   这项建筑工程需要场地访问权，并告诉市议会，我不在乎他们珍贵的草地边缘上的一些卡车轮胎车辙。

flashcards.definition: To stop or pause respecting decision or action; to be in suspense or uncertainty as to a determination.
flashcards.example: He hesitated whether to accept the offer or not; men often hesitate in forming a judgment.
flashcards.definitionZh: 停止或暂停尊重决定或行动；对决定感到悬而未决或不确定。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他犹豫着是否接受这个提议；人们在做出判断时常常犹豫不决。

flashcards.definition: A device for moving or compressing a liquid or gas.

flashcards.definitionZh: 用于移动或压缩液体或气体的装置。

flashcards.definitionZh: 骑自行车（尤其是自行车）或习惯骑自行车的人。
flashcards.exampleZh: 这是“骑自行车的人”这个词。

flashcards.definition: To produce an image or copy of.

flashcards.definitionZh: 一种近似圆柱形的容器，通常具有卷边端和螺旋盖，用于容纳和分配半液体物质。

flashcards.exampleZh: 信徒们聚集在一个血杯周围。

flashcards.definition: Small, moderate in size.

flashcards.definitionZh: 体积小，大小适中。
flashcards.exampleZh: 他挣的钱不多。

flashcards.exampleZh: 这就是奢华这个词。

flashcards.definition: The moral sense of right and wrong, chiefly as it affects one's own behaviour.

flashcards.exampleZh: 怀疑疾病的存在

flashcards.definition: To imagine or suppose (something) to be true, or to exist, without proof.
flashcards.example: to suspect the presence of disease
flashcards.definitionZh: 在没有证据的情况下想象或假设（某事）是真实的或存在的。
flashcards.exampleZh: 怀疑疾病的存在

flashcards.exampleZh: 微笑的怀疑
